Nory, a UK-based (London) AI-native restaurant back-office platform founded and led by CEO Conor Sheridan (co-founder of the Mad Egg restaurant chain), raised a $37M (EUR 31M) Series B led by Kinnevik in September 2025, bringing total funding to approximately $63M (EUR 58M); the round included participation from Series A lead Accel.

Nory's platform spans business intelligence, inventory, workforce management, payroll, and finance; the company states it is on track to serve close to 10% of the UK and Ireland multi-location restaurant market and is expanding into the US, with named customers including Black Sheep Coffee, Jamie Oliver Group, and Dave's Hot Chicken.

Nory reports that restaurants using its platform have achieved up to a 20% reduction in operating costs and net profit increases exceeding 50%, and that it helps operators save over 100 hours of admin per restaurant per month by automating back-office tasks. (Scope note: Aggregate performance figures are company-reported in investor/press materials, not independently audited per-customer results.)
